title: Claude Code pricing: billing basis and cost boundaries
summary: Claude Code pricing: billing basis and cost boundaries. Separate the recorded base price from unverified usage and operating costs.

sections.heading: Subscription evaluation
paragraphs: The recorded Pro subscription is USD 20 with monthly billing or USD 200 paid up front for a year. This is the subscription base, not a guarantee of unlimited coding. A token-cost display is not automatically the amount a subscriber will be charged; verify the account route and any extra-usage settings.

sections.heading: API evaluation
paragraphs: A cost estimate needs the model, input and output volumes, cache behavior and tool-use pattern. Without those inputs, converting tasks into dollars would be invented precision.

sections.heading: No task-to-credit exchange rate
paragraphs: A request, a credit and a token are not interchangeable. ToolPilot has not measured a representative workload across these products, so this guide does not invent a shared usage conversion or promise a fixed number of completed tasks.

verdict: Identify whether the account is subscription-based or API-billed before estimating a cost.
bestFor: Buyers checking Claude Code subscription and usage assumptions
notFor: Readers seeking a guaranteed workload total without measuring usage
migration: Trial the candidate on a branch; retain the original workflow until tests, export and billing checks pass.
